answer: In PoA, each identity posts bonded collateral, so coordinated equivocation by k identities triggers aggregate penalties proportional to k², not merely k. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the linked swarm, making large sybil sets economically self-defeating. Graph-linked evidence, from an ocean-scale validator set to a kernel-level audit and karst-like ownership structure, preserves attribution while asymmetric depreciation prevents recovery through rapid redeployment.
